about: The latest title in the acclaimed 'Empires' series is here, bringing together the fast-paced action of the Warriors series and territorial expansion strategy! A new, intuitive system of political management, in which the best officers can be simply placed in their most effective positions, makes its first appearance, while cooperative battles are powered up. Additional focus on historical episodes and the interplay between characters also serve to create a heightened sense of drama. 'Genesis Mode,' in which you can create your very own Warring States era, allows you more individual customization than ever before!
Enjoy the ultimate battle for supremacy!
A digital download will get the bonus DLC ' Special Costume' for 4 weeks after the game release. Please Access to PS store and get it for FREE!
*After 4 weeks, the bonus DLC will be paid DLC on PS store
Additional hardware required for Remote Play.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
